en.io: Input: optional review target and level 1-5; default is working-tree and staged diff at L2. Output: review verdict and counts, a .hyperflow/audits Markdown report, optional memory updates, and a fix-choice gate when applicable.
en.boundary: Produces review findings rather than directly fixing code unless the user chooses a fix path. Security violations halt and are surfaced immediately. Accuracy depends on reachable targets and gathered project context; referenced review and security policies are not attached in this evidence.
dependencies: Claude Code Agent, Skill, and AskUserQuestion capabilities
Hyperflow reviewer agents and prompt/reference files
Web research for current security advisories in gated specialist reviews
scenarios: Review unstaged and staged local changes.
Audit a file set, commit, branch, PR, or explicit Git range.
Run security-oriented review at L3 or deeper.
Turn selected findings into a fix specification and planning workflow.

zh.io: 输入：可选审查目标及 1-5 级别；默认审查工作区和暂存区差异，级别为 L2。输出：审查结论和计数、.hyperflow/audits Markdown 报告、可选记忆更新，以及适用时的修复选择门禁。
zh.boundary: 默认只产出审查发现；只有用户选择修复路径后才进入后续修复流程。安全违规会立即中止并显示。准确性依赖目标可访问性和项目上下文；本证据未附带被引用的审查与安全策略。
dependencies: Claude Code 的 Agent、Skill 和 AskUserQuestion 能力
Hyperflow 审查代理及提示词/引用文件
可写的 .hyperflow/audits 与记忆目录
门禁式安全审查所需的当前漏洞公告研究
scenarios: 审查未暂存和已暂存的本地改动。
审计文件集、提交、分支、PR 或明确的 Git 范围。
在 L3 或更高等级执行安全审查。
把选定发现转成修复规格并进入规划流程。
